guide.title: How to Export Your Data
guide.description: This guide outlines the steps to navigate to the Reports Hub and locate the data export feature. This allows you to download your full BKS ledger and vault for data portability.
steps: From the main vertical navigation bar on the left, click on the "Reports Hub" icon.
On the "Reports Hub" page, scroll to the bottom to find the "DATA PORTABILITY (ANTI-GREED)" section.
Click the "ACCESS DATA" link under the "Export My Data" heading to begin the export process.
